vulg: Paulus apostolus Christi Iesu per voluntatem Dei sanctis omnibus qui sunt Ephesi et fidelibus in Christo Iesu
clem: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, omnibus sanctis qui sunt Ephesi, et fidelibus in Christo Jesu.
tr: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου τοις αγιοις τοις ουσιν εν εφεσω και πιστοις εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

vulg: gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre nostro et Domino Iesu Christo
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui benedixit nos in omni benedictione spiritali in caelestibus in Christo
clem: Benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, qui benedixit nos in omni benedictione spirituali in clestibus in Christo,
tr: ευλογητος ο θεος και πατηρ του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο ευλογησας ημας εν παση ευλογια πνευματικη εν τοις επουρανιοις  εν  χριστω
kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

vulg: sicut elegit nos in ipso ante mundi constitutionem ut essemus sancti et inmaculati in conspectu eius in caritate
clem: sicut elegit nos in ipso ante mundi constitutionem, ut essemus sancti et immaculati in conspectu ejus in caritate.
tr: καθως εξελεξατο ημας εν αυτω προ καταβολης κοσμου ειναι ημας αγιους και αμωμους κατενωπιον αυτου εν αγαπη
kjv: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

vulg: qui praedestinavit nos in adoptionem filiorum per Iesum Christum in ipsum secundum propositum voluntatis suae
clem: Qui prdestinavit nos in adoptionem filiorum per Jesum Christum in ipsum: secundum propositum voluntatis su,
tr: προορισας ημας εις υιοθεσιαν δια ιησου χριστου εις αυτον κατα την ευδοκιαν του θεληματος αυτου
kjv: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

vulg: in laudem gloriae gratiae suae in qua gratificavit nos in dilecto
clem: in laudem glori grati su, in qua gratificavit nos in dilecto Filio suo.
tr: εις επαινον δοξης της χαριτος αυτου εν η εχαριτωσεν ημας εν τω ηγαπημενω
kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

vulg: in quo habemus redemptionem per sanguinem eius remissionem peccatorum secundum divitias gratiae eius
clem: In quo habemus redemptionem per sanguinem ejus, remissionem peccatorum secundum divitias grati ejus,
tr: εν ω εχομεν την απολυτρωσιν δια του αιματος αυτου την αφεσιν των παραπτωματων κατα τον πλουτον της χαριτος αυτου
kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

vulg: quae superabundavit in nobis in omni sapientia et prudentia
clem: qu superabundavit in nobis in omni sapientia et prudentia:
tr: ης επερισσευσεν εις ημας εν παση σοφια και φρονησει
kjv: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

vulg: ut notum faceret nobis sacramentum voluntatis suae secundum bonum placitum eius quod proposuit in eo
clem: ut notum faceret nobis sacramentum voluntatis su, secundum beneplacitum ejus, quod proposuit in eo,
tr: γνωρισας ημιν το μυστηριον του θεληματος αυτου κατα την ευδοκιαν αυτου ην προεθετο εν αυτω
kjv: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

vulg: in dispensationem plenitudinis temporum instaurare omnia in Christo quae in caelis et quae in terra sunt in ipso
clem: in dispensatione plenitudinis temporum, instaurare omnia in Christo, qu in clis et qu in terra sunt, in ipso;
tr: εις οικονομιαν του πληρωματος των καιρων ανακεφαλαιωσασθαι τα παντα εν τω χριστω τα τε εν τοις ουρανοις και τα επι της γης
kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

vulg: in quo etiam sorte vocati sumus praedestinati secundum propositum eius qui omnia operatur secundum consilium voluntatis suae
clem: in quo etiam et nos sorte vocati sumus prdestinati secundum propositum ejus qui operatur omnia secundum consilium voluntatis su:
tr: εν αυτω εν ω και εκληρωθημεν προορισθεντες κατα προθεσιν του τα παντα ενεργουντος κατα την βουλην του θεληματος αυτου
kjv: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

vulg: ut simus in laudem gloriae eius qui ante speravimus in Christo
clem: ut simus in laudem glori ejus nos, qui ante speravimus in Christo;
tr: εις το ειναι ημας εις επαινον της δοξης αυτου τους προηλπικοτας εν τω χριστω
kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

vulg: in quo et vos cum audissetis verbum veritatis evangelium salutis vestrae in quo et credentes signati estis Spiritu promissionis Sancto
clem: in quo et vos, cum audissetis verbum veritatis, Evangelium salutis vestr, in quo et credentes signati estis Spiritu promissionis Sancto,
tr: εν ω και υμεις ακουσαντες τον λογον της αληθειας το ευαγγελιον της σωτηριας υμων εν ω και πιστευσαντες εσφραγισθητε τω πνευματι της επαγγελιας τω αγιω
kjv: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

vulg: qui est pignus hereditatis nostrae in redemptionem adquisitionis in laudem gloriae ipsius
clem: qui est pignus hreditatis nostr, in redemptionem acquisitionis, in laudem glori ipsius.
tr: ος εστιν αρραβων της κληρονομιας ημων εις απολυτρωσιν της περιποιησεως εις επαινον της δοξης αυτου
kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

vulg: propterea et ego audiens fidem vestram quae est in Domino Iesu et dilectionem in omnes sanctos
clem: Propterea et ego audiens fidem vestram, qu est in Domino Jesu, et dilectionem in omnes sanctos,
tr: δια τουτο καγω ακουσας την καθ υμας πιστιν εν τω κυριω ιησου και την αγαπην την εις παντας τους αγιους
kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

vulg: non cesso gratias agens pro vobis memoriam vestri faciens in orationibus meis
clem: non cesso gratias agens pro vobis, memoriam vestri faciens in orationibus meis:
tr: ου παυομαι ευχαριστων υπερ υμων μνειαν υμων ποιουμενος επι των προσευχων μου
kjv: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

vulg: ut Deus Domini nostri Iesu Christi Pater gloriae det vobis spiritum sapientiae et revelationis in agnitione eius
clem: ut Deus Domini nostri Jesu Christi, Pater glori, det vobis spiritum sapienti et revelationis in agnitione ejus,
tr: ινα ο θεος του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο πατηρ της δοξης δωη υμιν πνευμα σοφιας και αποκαλυψεως εν επιγνωσει αυτου
kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

vulg: inluminatos oculos cordis vestri ut sciatis quae sit spes vocationis eius quae divitiae gloriae hereditatis eius in sanctis
clem: illuminatos oculos cordis vestri, ut sciatis qu sit spes vocationis ejus, et qu diviti glori hreditatis ejus in sanctis,
tr: πεφωτισμενους τους οφθαλμους της διανοιας υμων εις το ειδεναι υμας τις εστιν η ελπις της κλησεως αυτου και τις ο πλουτος της δοξης της κληρονομιας αυτου εν τοις αγιοις
kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

vulg: et quae sit supereminens magnitudo virtutis eius in nos qui credidimus secundum operationem potentiae virtutis eius
clem: et qu sit supereminens magnitudo virtutis ejus in nos, qui credimus secundum operationem potenti virtutis ejus,
tr: και τι το υπερβαλλον μεγεθος της δυναμεως αυτου εις ημας τους πιστευοντας κατα την ενεργειαν του κρατους της ισχυος αυτου
kjv: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

vulg: quam operatus est in Christo suscitans illum a mortuis et constituens ad dexteram suam in caelestibus
clem: quam operatus est in Christo, suscitans illum a mortuis, et constituens ad dexteram suam in clestibus:
tr: ην ενηργησεν εν τω χριστω εγειρας αυτον εκ νεκρων και εκαθισεν εν δεξια αυτου εν τοις επουρανιοις
kjv: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

vulg: supra omnem principatum et potestatem et virtutem et dominationem et omne nomen quod nominatur non solum in hoc saeculo sed et in futuro
clem: supra omnem principatum, et potestatem, et virtutem, et dominationem, et omne nomen, quod nominatur non solum in hoc sculo, sed etiam in futuro.
tr: υπερανω πασης αρχης και εξουσιας και δυναμεως και κυριοτητος και παντος ονοματος ονομαζομενου ου μονον εν τω αιωνι τουτω αλλα και εν τω μελλοντι
kjv: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

vulg: et omnia subiecit sub pedibus eius et ipsum dedit caput supra omnia ecclesiae
clem: Et omnia subjecit sub pedibus ejus: et ipsum dedit caput supra omnem ecclesiam,
tr: και παντα υπεταξεν υπο τους ποδας αυτου και αυτον εδωκεν κεφαλην υπερ παντα τη εκκλησια
kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

vulg: quae est corpus ipsius plenitudo eius qui omnia in omnibus adimpletur
clem: qu est corpus ipsius, et plenitudo ejus, qui omnia in omnibus adimpletur.
tr: ητις εστιν το σωμα αυτου το πληρωμα του παντα εν πασιν πληρουμενου
kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

vulg: et vos cum essetis mortui delictis et peccatis vestris
clem: Et vos, cum essetis mortui delictis et peccatis vestris,
tr: και υμας οντας νεκρους τοις παραπτωμασιν και ταις αμαρτιαις
kjv: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

vulg: in quibus aliquando ambulastis secundum saeculum mundi huius secundum principem potestatis aeris huius spiritus qui nunc operatur in filios diffidentiae
clem: in quibus aliquando ambulastis secundum sculum mundi hujus, secundum principem potestatis aris hujus, spiritus, qui nunc operatur in filios diffidenti,
tr: εν αις ποτε περιεπατησατε κατα τον αιωνα του κοσμου τουτου κατα τον αρχοντα της εξουσιας του αερος του πνευματος του νυν ενεργουντος εν τοις υιοις της απειθειας
kjv: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

vulg: in quibus et nos omnes aliquando conversati sumus in desideriis carnis nostrae facientes voluntates carnis et cogitationum et eramus natura filii irae sicut et ceteri
clem: in quibus et nos omnes aliquando conversati sumus in desideriis carnis nostr, facientes voluntatem carnis et cogitationum, et eramus natura filii ir, sicut et ceteri:
tr: εν οις και ημεις παντες ανεστραφημεν ποτε εν ταις επιθυμιαις της σαρκος ημων ποιουντες τα θεληματα της σαρκος και των διανοιων και ημεν τεκνα φυσει οργης ως και οι λοιποι
kjv: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

vulg: Deus autem qui dives est in misericordia propter nimiam caritatem suam qua dilexit nos
clem: Deus autem, qui dives est in misericordia, propter nimiam caritatem suam, qua dilexit nos,
tr: ο δε θεος πλουσιος ων εν ελεει δια την πολλην αγαπην αυτου ην ηγαπησεν ημας
kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

vulg: et cum essemus mortui peccatis convivificavit nos Christo gratia estis salvati
clem: et cum essemus mortui peccatis, convivificavit nos in Christo (cujus gratia estis salvati),
tr: και οντας ημας νεκρους τοις παραπτωμασιν συνεζωοποιησεν τω χριστω χαριτι εστε σεσωσμενοι
kjv: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

vulg: et conresuscitavit et consedere fecit in caelestibus in Christo Iesu
clem: et conresuscitavit, et consedere fecit in clestibus in Christo Jesu:
tr: και συνηγειρεν και συνεκαθισεν εν τοις επουρανιοις εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

vulg: ut ostenderet in saeculis supervenientibus abundantes divitias gratiae suae in bonitate super nos in Christo Iesu
clem: ut ostenderet in sculis supervenientibus abundantes divitias grati su, in bonitate super nos in Christo Jesu.
tr: ινα ενδειξηται εν τοις αιωσιν τοις επερχομενοις τον υπερβαλλοντα πλουτον της χαριτος αυτου εν χρηστοτητι εφ ημας εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

vulg: gratia enim estis salvati per fidem et hoc non ex vobis Dei enim donum est
clem: Gratia enim estis salvati per fidem, et hoc non ex vobis: Dei enim donum est:
tr: τη γαρ χαριτι εστε σεσωσμενοι δια της πιστεως και τουτο ουκ εξ υμων θεου το δωρον
kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

vulg: non ex operibus ut ne quis glorietur
clem: non ex operibus, ut ne quis glorietur.
tr: ουκ εξ εργων ινα μη τις καυχησηται
kjv: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

vulg: ipsius enim sumus factura creati in Christo Iesu in operibus bonis quae praeparavit Deus ut in illis ambulemus
clem: Ipsius enim sumus factura, creati in Christo Jesu in operibus bonis, qu prparavit Deus ut in illis ambulemus.
tr: αυτου γαρ εσμεν ποιημα κτισθεντες εν χριστω ιησου επι εργοις αγαθοις οις προητοιμασεν ο θεος ινα εν αυτοις περιπατησωμεν
kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

vulg: propter quod memores estote quod aliquando vos gentes in carne qui dicimini praeputium ab ea quae dicitur circumcisio in carne manufacta
clem: Propter quod memores estote quod aliquando vos gentes in carne, qui dicimini prputium ab ea qu dicitur circumcisio in carne, manu facta:
tr: διο μνημονευετε οτι υμεις ποτε τα εθνη εν σαρκι οι λεγομενοι ακροβυστια υπο της λεγομενης περιτομης εν σαρκι χειροποιητου
kjv: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

vulg: quia eratis illo in tempore sine Christo alienati a conversatione Israhel et hospites testamentorum promissionis spem non habentes et sine Deo in mundo
clem: quia eratis illo in tempore sine Christo, alienati a conversatione Isral, et hospites testamentorum, promissionis spem non habentes, et sine Deo in hoc mundo.
tr: οτι ητε εν τω καιρω εκεινω χωρις χριστου απηλλοτριωμενοι της πολιτειας του ισραηλ και ξενοι των διαθηκων της επαγγελιας ελπιδα μη εχοντες και αθεοι εν τω κοσμω
kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

vulg: nunc autem in Christo Iesu vos qui aliquando eratis longe facti estis prope in sanguine Christi
clem: Nunc autem in Christo Jesu, vos, qui aliquando eratis longe, facti estis prope in sanguine Christi.
tr: νυνι δε εν χριστω ιησου υμεις οι ποτε οντες μακραν εγγυς εγενηθητε εν τω αιματι του χριστου
kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

vulg: ipse est enim pax nostra qui fecit utraque unum et medium parietem maceriae solvens inimicitiam in carne sua
clem: Ipse enim est pax nostra, qui fecit utraque unum, et medium parietem maceri solvens, inimicitias in carne sua,
tr: αυτος γαρ εστιν η ειρηνη ημων ο ποιησας τα αμφοτερα εν και το μεσοτοιχον του φραγμου λυσας
kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

vulg: legem mandatorum decretis evacuans ut duos condat in semet ipsum in unum novum hominem faciens pacem
clem: legem mandatorum decretis evacuans, ut duos condat in semetipso in unum novum hominem, faciens pacem:
tr: την εχθραν εν τη σαρκι αυτου τον νομον των εντολων εν δογμασιν καταργησας ινα τους δυο κτιση εν εαυτω εις ενα καινον ανθρωπον ποιων ειρηνην
kjv: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

vulg: et reconciliet ambos in uno corpore Deo per crucem interficiens inimicitiam in semet ipso
clem: et reconciliet ambos in uno corpore, Deo per crucem, interficiens inimicitias in semetipso.
tr: και αποκαταλλαξη τους αμφοτερους εν ενι σωματι τω θεω δια του σταυρου αποκτεινας την εχθραν εν αυτω
kjv: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

vulg: et veniens evangelizavit pacem vobis qui longe fuistis et pacem his qui prope
clem: Et veniens evangelizavit pacem vobis, qui longe fuistis, et pacem iis, qui prope.
tr: και ελθων ευηγγελισατο ειρηνην υμιν τοις μακραν και τοις εγγυς
kjv: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

vulg: quoniam per ipsum habemus accessum ambo in uno Spiritu ad Patrem
clem: Quoniam per ipsum habemus accessum ambo in uno Spiritu ad Patrem.
tr: οτι δι αυτου εχομεν την προσαγωγην οι αμφοτεροι εν ενι πνευματι προς τον πατερα
kjv: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

vulg: ergo iam non estis hospites et advenae sed estis cives sanctorum et domestici Dei
clem: Ergo jam non estis hospites, et adven: sed estis cives sanctorum, et domestici Dei,
tr: αρα ουν ουκετι εστε ξενοι και παροικοι αλλα συμπολιται των αγιων και οικειοι του θεου
kjv: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

vulg: superaedificati super fundamentum apostolorum et prophetarum ipso summo angulari lapide Christo Iesu
clem: superdificati super fundamentum apostolorum, et prophetarum, ipso summo angulari lapide Christo Jesu:
tr: εποικοδομηθεντες επι τω θεμελιω των αποστολων και προφητων οντος ακρογωνιαιου αυτου ιησου χριστου
kjv: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

vulg: in quo omnis aedificatio constructa crescit in templum sanctum in Domino
clem: in quo omnis dificatio constructa crescit in templum sanctum in Domino,
tr: εν ω πασα η οικοδομη συναρμολογουμενη αυξει εις ναον αγιον εν κυριω
kjv: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

vulg: in quo et vos coaedificamini in habitaculum Dei in Spiritu
clem: in quo et vos codificamini in habitaculum Dei in Spiritu.
tr: εν ω και υμεις συνοικοδομεισθε εις κατοικητηριον του θεου εν πνευματι
kjv: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

vulg: huius rei gratia ego Paulus vinctus Christi Iesu pro vobis gentibus
clem: Hujus rei gratia, ego Paulus vinctus Christi Jesu, pro vobis gentibus,
tr: τουτου χαριν εγω παυλος ο δεσμιος του χριστου ιησου υπερ υμων των εθνων
kjv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

vulg: si tamen audistis dispensationem gratiae Dei quae data est mihi in vobis
clem: si tamen audistis dispensationem grati Dei, qu data est mihi in vobis:
tr: ειγε ηκουσατε την οικονομιαν της χαριτος του θεου της δοθεισης μοι εις υμας
kjv: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

vulg: quoniam secundum revelationem notum mihi factum est sacramentum sicut supra scripsi in brevi
clem: quoniam secundum revelationem notum mihi factum est sacramentum, sicut supra scripsi in brevi,
tr: οτι κατα αποκαλυψιν εγνωρισεν μοι το μυστηριον καθως προεγραψα εν ολιγω
kjv: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

vulg: prout potestis legentes intellegere prudentiam meam in mysterio Christi
clem: prout potestis legentes intelligere prudentiam meam in mysterio Christi:
tr: προς ο δυνασθε αναγινωσκοντες νοησαι την συνεσιν μου εν τω μυστηριω του χριστου
kjv: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

vulg: quod aliis generationibus non est agnitum filiis hominum sicuti nunc revelatum est sanctis apostolis eius et prophetis in Spiritu
clem: quod aliis generationibus non est agnitum filiis hominum, sicuti nunc revelatum est sanctis apostolis ejus et prophetis in Spiritu,
tr: ο εν ετεραις γενεαις ουκ εγνωρισθη τοις υιοις των ανθρωπων ως νυν απεκαλυφθη τοις αγιοις αποστολοις αυτου και προφηταις εν πνευματι
kjv: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

vulg: esse gentes coheredes et concorporales et conparticipes promissionis in Christo Iesu per evangelium
clem: gentes esse cohredes, et concorporales, et comparticipes promissionis ejus in Christo Jesu per Evangelium:
tr: ειναι τα εθνη συγκληρονομα και συσσωμα και συμμετοχα της επαγγελιας αυτου εν τω χριστω δια του ευαγγελιου
kjv: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

vulg: cuius factus sum minister secundum donum gratiae Dei quae data est mihi secundum operationem virtutis eius
clem: cujus factus sum minister secundum donum grati Dei, qu data est mihi secundum operationem virtutis ejus.
tr: ου εγενομην διακονος κατα την δωρεαν της χαριτος του θεου την δοθεισαν μοι κατα την ενεργειαν της δυναμεως αυτου
kjv: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

vulg: mihi omnium sanctorum minimo data est gratia haec in gentibus evangelizare ininvestigabiles divitias Christi
clem: Mihi omnium sanctorum minimo data est gratia hc, in gentibus evangelizare investigabiles divitias Christi,
tr: εμοι τω ελαχιστοτερω παντων των αγιων εδοθη η χαρις αυτη εν τοις εθνεσιν ευαγγελισασθαι τον ανεξιχνιαστον πλουτον του χριστου
kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

vulg: et inluminare omnes quae sit dispensatio sacramenti absconditi a saeculis in Deo qui omnia creavit
clem: et illuminare omnes, qu sit dispensatio sacramenti absconditi a sculis in Deo, qui omnia creavit:
tr: και φωτισαι παντας τις η κοινωνια του μυστηριου του αποκεκρυμμενου απο των αιωνων εν τω θεω τω τα παντα κτισαντι δια ιησου χριστου
kjv: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

vulg: ut innotescat principibus et potestatibus in caelestibus per ecclesiam multiformis sapientia Dei
clem: ut innotescat principatibus et potestatibus in clestibus per Ecclesiam, multiformis sapientia Dei,
tr: ινα γνωρισθη νυν ταις αρχαις και ταις εξουσιαις εν τοις επουρανιοις δια της εκκλησιας η πολυποικιλος σοφια του θεου
kjv: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

vulg: secundum praefinitionem saeculorum quam fecit in Christo Iesu Domino nostro
clem: secundum prfinitionem sculorum, quam fecit in Christo Jesu Domino nostro:
tr: κατα προθεσιν των αιωνων ην εποιησεν εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
kjv: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

vulg: in quo habemus fiduciam et accessum in confidentia per fidem eius
clem: in quo habemus fiduciam, et accessum in confidentia per fidem ejus.
tr: εν ω εχομεν την παρρησιαν και την προσαγωγην εν πεποιθησει δια της πιστεως αυτου
kjv: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

vulg: propter quod peto ne deficiatis in tribulationibus meis pro vobis quae est gloria vestra
clem: Propter quod peto ne deficiatis in tribulationibus meis pro vobis: qu est gloria vestra.
tr: διο αιτουμαι μη εκκακειν εν ταις θλιψεσιν μου υπερ υμων ητις εστιν δοξα υμων
kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

vulg: huius rei gratia flecto genua mea ad Patrem Domini nostri Iesu Christi
clem: Hujus rei gratia flecto genua mea ad Patrem Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
tr: τουτου χαριν καμπτω τα γονατα μου προς τον πατερα του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

vulg: ex quo omnis paternitas in caelis et in terra nominatur
clem: ex quo omnis paternitas in clis et in terra nominatur,
tr: εξ ου πασα πατρια εν ουρανοις και επι γης ονομαζεται
kjv: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

vulg: ut det vobis secundum divitias gloriae suae virtute corroborari per Spiritum eius in interiore homine
clem: ut det vobis secundum divitias glori su, virtute corroborari per Spiritum ejus in interiorem hominem,
tr: ινα δωη υμιν κατα τον πλουτον της δοξης αυτου δυναμει κραταιωθηναι δια του πνευματος αυτου εις τον εσω ανθρωπον
kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

vulg: habitare Christum per fidem in cordibus vestris in caritate radicati et fundati
clem: Christum habitare per fidem in cordibus vestris: in caritate radicati, et fundati,
tr: κατοικησαι τον χριστον δια της πιστεως εν ταις καρδιαις υμων (3:18) εν αγαπη ερριζωμενοι και τεθεμελιωμενοι
kjv: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

vulg: ut possitis conprehendere cum omnibus sanctis quae sit latitudo et longitudo et sublimitas et profundum
clem: ut possitis comprehendere cum omnibus sanctis, qu sit latitudo, et longitudo, et sublimitas, et profundum:
tr: ινα εξισχυσητε καταλαβεσθαι συν πασιν τοις αγιοις τι το πλατος και μηκος και βαθος και υψος
kjv: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

vulg: scire etiam supereminentem scientiae caritatem Christi ut impleamini in omnem plenitudinem Dei
clem: scire etiam supereminentem scienti caritatem Christi, ut impleamini in omnem plenitudinem Dei.
tr: γνωναι τε την υπερβαλλουσαν της γνωσεως αγαπην του χριστου ινα πληρωθητε εις παν το πληρωμα του θεου
kjv: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

vulg: ei autem qui potens est omnia facere superabundanter quam petimus aut intellegimus secundum virtutem quae operatur in nobis
clem: Ei autem, qui potens est omnia facere superabundanter quam petimus aut intelligimus, secundum virtutem, qu operatur in nobis:
tr: τω δε δυναμενω υπερ παντα ποιησαι υπερ εκ περισσου ων αιτουμεθα η νοουμεν κατα την δυναμιν την ενεργουμενην εν ημιν
kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

vulg: ipsi gloria in ecclesia et in Christo Iesu in omnes generationes saeculi saeculorum amen
clem: ipsi gloria in Ecclesia, et in Christo Jesu, in omnes generationes sculi sculorum. Amen.
tr: αυτω η δοξα εν τη εκκλησια εν χριστω ιησου εις πασας τας γενεας του αιωνος των αιωνων αμην
kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

vulg: obsecro itaque vos ego vinctus in Domino ut digne ambuletis vocatione qua vocati estis
clem: Obsecro itaque vos ego vinctus in Domino, ut digne ambuletis vocatione, qua vocati estis,
tr: παρακαλω ουν υμας εγω ο δεσμιος εν κυριω αξιως περιπατησαι της κλησεως ης εκληθητε
kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

vulg: cum omni humilitate et mansuetudine cum patientia subportantes invicem in caritate
clem: cum omni humilitate, et mansuetudine, cum patientia, supportantes invicem in caritate,
tr: μετα πασης ταπεινοφροσυνης και πραοτητος μετα μακροθυμιας ανεχομενοι αλληλων εν αγαπη
kjv: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

vulg: solliciti servare unitatem spiritus in vinculo pacis
clem: solliciti servare unitatem Spiritus in vinculo pacis.
tr: σπουδαζοντες τηρειν την ενοτητα του πνευματος εν τω συνδεσμω της ειρηνης
kjv: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

vulg: unum corpus et unus spiritus sicut vocati estis in una spe vocationis vestrae
clem: Unum corpus, et unus Spiritus, sicut vocati estis in una spe vocationis vestr.
tr: εν σωμα και εν πνευμα καθως και εκληθητε εν μια ελπιδι της κλησεως υμων
kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

vulg: unus Dominus una fides unum baptisma
clem: Unus Dominus, una fides, unum baptisma.
tr: εις κυριος μια πιστις εν βαπτισμα
kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

vulg: unus Deus et Pater omnium qui super omnes et per omnia et in omnibus nobis
clem: Unus Deus et Pater omnium, qui est super omnes, et per omnia, et in omnibus nobis.
tr: εις θεος και πατηρ παντων ο επι παντων και δια παντων και εν πασιν υμιν
kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

vulg: unicuique autem nostrum data est gratia secundum mensuram donationis Christi
clem: Unicuique autem nostrum data est gratia secundum mensuram donationis Christi.
tr: ενι δε εκαστω ημων εδοθη η χαρις κατα το μετρον της δωρεας του χριστου
kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

vulg: propter quod dicit ascendens in altum captivam duxit captivitatem dedit dona hominibus
clem: Propter quod dicit: Ascendens in altum, captivam duxit captivitatem: dedit dona hominibus.
tr: διο λεγει αναβας εις υψος ηχμαλωτευσεν αιχμαλωσιαν και εδωκεν δοματα τοις ανθρωποις
kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

vulg: quod autem ascendit quid est nisi quia et descendit primum in inferiores partes terrae
clem: Quod autem ascendit, quid est, nisi quia et descendit primum in inferiores partes terr?
tr: το δε ανεβη τι εστιν ει μη οτι και κατεβη πρωτον εις τα κατωτερα μερη της γης
kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

vulg: qui descendit ipse est et qui ascendit super omnes caelos ut impleret omnia
clem: Qui descendit, ipse est et qui ascendit super omnes clos, ut impleret omnia.
tr: ο καταβας αυτος εστιν και ο αναβας υπερανω παντων των ουρανων ινα πληρωση τα παντα
kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

vulg: et ipse dedit quosdam quidem apostolos quosdam autem prophetas alios vero evangelistas alios autem pastores et doctores
clem: Et ipse dedit quosdam quidem apostolos, quosdam autem prophetas, alios vero evangelistas, alios autem pastores et doctores,
tr: και αυτος εδωκεν τους μεν αποστολους τους δε προφητας τους δε ευαγγελιστας τους δε ποιμενας και διδασκαλους
kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

vulg: ad consummationem sanctorum in opus ministerii in aedificationem corporis Christi
clem: ad consummationem sanctorum in opus ministerii, in dificationem corporis Christi:
tr: προς τον καταρτισμον των αγιων εις εργον διακονιας εις οικοδομην του σωματος του χριστου
kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

vulg: donec occurramus omnes in unitatem fidei et agnitionis Filii Dei in virum perfectum in mensuram aetatis plenitudinis Christi
clem: donec occurramus omnes in unitatem fidei, et agnitionis Filii Dei, in virum perfectum, in mensuram tatis plenitudinis Christi:
tr: μεχρι καταντησωμεν οι παντες εις την ενοτητα της πιστεως και της επιγνωσεως του υιου του θεου εις ανδρα τελειον εις μετρον ηλικιας του πληρωματος του χριστου
kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

vulg: ut iam non simus parvuli fluctuantes et circumferamur omni vento doctrinae in nequitia hominum in astutia ad circumventionem erroris
clem: ut jam non simus parvuli fluctuantes, et circumferamur omni vento doctrin in nequitia hominum, in astutia ad circumventionem erroris.
tr: ινα μηκετι ωμεν νηπιοι κλυδωνιζομενοι και περιφερομενοι παντι ανεμω της διδασκαλιας εν τη κυβεια των ανθρωπων εν πανουργια προς την μεθοδειαν της πλανης
kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

vulg: veritatem autem facientes in caritate crescamus in illo per omnia qui est caput Christus
clem: Veritatem autem facientes in caritate, crescamus in illo per omnia, qui est caput Christus:
tr: αληθευοντες δε εν αγαπη αυξησωμεν εις αυτον τα παντα ος εστιν η κεφαλη ο χριστος
kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

vulg: ex quo totum corpus conpactum et conexum per omnem iuncturam subministrationis secundum operationem in mensuram uniuscuiusque membri augmentum corporis facit in aedificationem sui in caritate
clem: ex quo totum corpus compactum et connexum per omnem juncturam subministrationis, secundum operationem in mensuram uniuscujusque membri, augmentum corporis facit in dificationem sui in caritate.
tr: εξ ου παν το σωμα συναρμολογουμενον και συμβιβαζομενον δια πασης αφης της επιχορηγιας κατ ενεργειαν εν μετρω ενος εκαστου μερους την αυξησιν του σωματος ποιειται εις οικοδομην εαυτου εν αγαπη
kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

vulg: hoc igitur dico et testificor in Domino ut iam non ambuletis sicut gentes ambulant in vanitate sensus sui
clem: Hoc igitur dico, et testificor in Domino, ut jam non ambuletis, sicut et gentes ambulant in vanitate sensus sui,
tr: τουτο ουν λεγω και μαρτυρομαι εν κυριω μηκετι υμας περιπατειν καθως και τα λοιπα εθνη περιπατει εν ματαιοτητι του νοος αυτων
kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

vulg: tenebris obscuratum habentes intellectum alienati a vita Dei per ignorantiam quae est in illis propter caecitatem cordis ipsorum
clem: tenebris obscuratum habentes intellectum, alienati a vita Dei per ignorantiam, qu est in illis, propter ccitatem cordis ipsorum,
tr: εσκοτισμενοι τη διανοια οντες απηλλοτριωμενοι της ζωης του θεου δια την αγνοιαν την ουσαν εν αυτοις δια την πωρωσιν της καρδιας αυτων
kjv: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

vulg: qui desperantes semet ipsos tradiderunt inpudicitiae in operationem inmunditiae omnis in avaritia
clem: qui desperantes, semetipsos tradiderunt impudiciti, in operationem immunditi omnis in avaritiam.
tr: οιτινες απηλγηκοτες εαυτους παρεδωκαν τη ασελγεια εις εργασιαν ακαθαρσιας πασης εν πλεονεξια
kjv: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

vulg: vos autem non ita didicistis Christum
clem: Vos autem non ita didicistis Christum,
tr: υμεις δε ουχ ουτως εμαθετε τον χριστον
kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;

vulg: si tamen illum audistis et in ipso edocti estis sicut est veritas in Iesu
clem: si tamen illum audistis, et in ipso edocti estis, sicut est veritas in Jesu,
tr: ειγε αυτον ηκουσατε και εν αυτω εδιδαχθητε καθως εστιν αληθεια εν τω ιησου
kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

vulg: deponere vos secundum pristinam conversationem veterem hominem qui corrumpitur secundum desideria erroris
clem: deponere vos secundum pristinam conversationem veterem hominem, qui corrumpitur secundum desideria erroris.
tr: αποθεσθαι υμας κατα την προτεραν αναστροφην τον παλαιον ανθρωπον τον φθειρομενον κατα τας επιθυμιας της απατης
kjv: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

vulg: renovamini autem spiritu mentis vestrae
clem: Renovamini autem spiritu mentis vestr,
tr: ανανεουσθαι δε τω πνευματι του νοος υμων
kjv: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

vulg: et induite novum hominem qui secundum Deum creatus est in iustitia et sanctitate veritatis
clem: et induite novum hominem, qui secundum Deum creatus est in justitia, et sanctitate veritatis.
tr: και ενδυσασθαι τον καινον ανθρωπον τον κατα θεον κτισθεντα εν δικαιοσυνη και οσιοτητι της αληθειας
kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

vulg: propter quod deponentes mendacium loquimini veritatem unusquisque cum proximo suo quoniam sumus invicem membra
clem: Propter quod deponentes mendacium, loquimini veritatem unusquisque cum proximo suo: quoniam sumus invicem membra.
tr: διο αποθεμενοι το ψευδος λαλειτε αληθειαν εκαστος μετα του πλησιον αυτου οτι εσμεν αλληλων μελη
kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

vulg: irascimini et nolite peccare sol non occidat super iracundiam vestram
clem: Irascimini, et nolite peccare: sol non occidat super iracundiam vestram.
tr: οργιζεσθε και μη αμαρτανετε ο ηλιος μη επιδυετω επι τω παροργισμω υμων
kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

vulg: nolite locum dare diabolo
clem: Nolite locum dare diabolo:
tr: μητε διδοτε τοπον τω διαβολω
kjv: Neither give place to the devil.

vulg: qui furabatur iam non furetur magis autem laboret operando manibus quod bonum est ut habeat unde tribuat necessitatem patienti
clem: qui furabatur, jam non furetur: magis autem laboret, operando manibus suis, quod bonum est, ut habeat unde tribuat necessitatem patienti.
tr: ο κλεπτων μηκετι κλεπτετω μαλλον δε κοπιατω εργαζομενος το αγαθον ταις χερσιν ινα εχη μεταδιδοναι τω χρειαν εχοντι
kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

vulg: omnis sermo malus ex ore vestro non procedat sed si quis bonus ad aedificationem oportunitatis ut det gratiam audientibus
clem: Omnis sermo malus ex ore vestro non procedat: sed si quis bonus ad dificationem fidei ut det gratiam audientibus.
tr: πας λογος σαπρος εκ του στοματος υμων μη εκπορευεσθω αλλ ει τις αγαθος προς οικοδομην της χρειας ινα δω χαριν τοις ακουουσιν
kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

vulg: et nolite contristare Spiritum Sanctum Dei in quo signati estis in die redemptionis
clem: Et nolite constristare Spiritum Sanctum Dei: in quo signati estis in diem redemptionis.
tr: και μη λυπειτε το πνευμα το αγιον του θεου εν ω εσφραγισθητε εις ημεραν απολυτρωσεως
kjv: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

vulg: omnis amaritudo et ira et indignatio et clamor et blasphemia tollatur a vobis cum omni malitia
clem: Omnis amaritudo, et ira, et indignatio, et clamor, et blasphemia tollatur a vobis cum omni malitia.
tr: πασα πικρια και θυμος και οργη και κραυγη και βλασφημια αρθητω αφ υμων συν παση κακια
kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

vulg: estote autem invicem benigni misericordes donantes invicem sicut et Deus in Christo donavit nobis
clem: Estote autem invicem benigni, misericordes, donantes invicem sicut et Deus in Christo donavit vobis.
tr: γινεσθε δε εις αλληλους χρηστοι ευσπλαγχνοι χαριζομενοι εαυτοις καθως και ο θεος εν χριστω εχαρισατο υμιν
kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

vulg: estote ergo imitatores Dei sicut filii carissimi
clem: Estote ergo imitatores Dei, sicut filii carissimi,
tr: γινεσθε ουν μιμηται του θεου ως τεκνα αγαπητα
kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

vulg: et ambulate in dilectione sicut et Christus dilexit nos et tradidit se ipsum pro nobis oblationem et hostiam Deo in odorem suavitatis
clem: et ambulate in dilectione, sicut et Christus dilexit nos, et tradidit semetipsum pro nobis, oblationem et hostiam Deo in odorem suavitatis.
tr: και περιπατειτε εν αγαπη καθως και ο χριστος ηγαπησεν ημας και παρεδωκεν εαυτον υπερ ημων προσφοραν και θυσιαν τω θεω εις οσμην ευωδιας
kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

vulg: fornicatio autem et omnis inmunditia aut avaritia nec nominetur in vobis sicut decet sanctos
clem: Fornicatio autem, et omnis immunditia, aut avaritia, nec nominetur in vobis, sicut decet sanctos:
tr: πορνεια δε και πασα ακαθαρσια η πλεονεξια μηδε ονομαζεσθω εν υμιν καθως πρεπει αγιοις
kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

vulg: aut turpitudo aut stultiloquium aut scurrilitas quae ad rem non pertinent sed magis gratiarum actio
clem: aut turpitudo, aut stultiloquium, aut scurrilitas, qu ad rem non pertinet: sed magis gratiarum actio.
tr: και αισχροτης και μωρολογια η ευτραπελια τα ουκ ανηκοντα αλλα μαλλον ευχαριστια
kjv: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

vulg: hoc enim scitote intellegentes quod omnis fornicator aut inmundus aut avarus quod est idolorum servitus non habet hereditatem in regno Christi et Dei
clem: Hoc enim scitote intelligentes: quod omnis fornicator, aut immundus, aut avarus, quod est idolorum servitus, non habet hreditatem in regno Christi et Dei.
tr: τουτο γαρ εστε γινωσκοντες οτι πας πορνος η ακαθαρτος η πλεονεκτης ος εστιν ειδωλολατρης ουκ εχει κληρονομιαν εν τη βασιλεια του χριστου και θεου
kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

vulg: nemo vos seducat inanibus verbis propter haec enim venit ira Dei in filios diffidentiae
clem: Nemo vos seducat inanibus verbis: propter hc enim venit ira Dei in filios diffidenti.
tr: μηδεις υμας απατατω κενοις λογοις δια ταυτα γαρ ερχεται η οργη του θεου επι τους υιους της απειθειας
kjv: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

vulg: nolite ergo effici participes eorum
clem: Nolite ergo effici participes eorum.
tr: μη ουν γινεσθε συμμετοχοι αυτων
kjv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

vulg: eratis enim aliquando tenebrae nunc autem lux in Domino ut filii lucis ambulate
clem: Eratis enim aliquando tenebr: nunc autem lux in Domino. Ut filii lucis ambulate:
tr: ητε γαρ ποτε σκοτος νυν δε φως εν κυριω ως τεκνα φωτος περιπατειτε
kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

vulg: fructus enim lucis est in omni bonitate et iustitia et veritate
clem: fructus enim lucis est in omni bonitate, et justitia, et veritate:
tr: ο γαρ καρπος του πνευματος εν παση αγαθωσυνη και δικαιοσυνη και αληθεια
kjv: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

vulg: probantes quid sit beneplacitum Deo
clem: probantes quid sit beneplacitum Deo:
tr: δοκιμαζοντες τι εστιν ευαρεστον τω κυριω
kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

vulg: et nolite communicare operibus infructuosis tenebrarum magis autem et redarguite
clem: et nolite communicare operibus infructuosis tenebrarum, magis autem redarguite.
tr: και μη συγκοινωνειτε τοις εργοις τοις ακαρποις του σκοτους μαλλον δε και ελεγχετε
kjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

vulg: quae enim in occulto fiunt ab ipsis turpe est et dicere
clem: Qu enim in occulto fiunt ab ipsis, turpe est et dicere.
tr: τα γαρ κρυφη γινομενα υπ αυτων αισχρον εστιν και λεγειν
kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

vulg: omnia autem quae arguuntur a lumine manifestantur omne enim quod manifestatur lumen est
clem: Omnia autem, qu arguuntur, a lumine manifestantur: omne enim, quod manifestatur, lumen est.
tr: τα δε παντα ελεγχομενα υπο του φωτος φανερουται παν γαρ το φανερουμενον φως εστιν
kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

vulg: propter quod dicit surge qui dormis et exsurge a mortuis et inluminabit tibi Christus
clem: Propter quod dicit: Surge qui dormis, et exsurge a mortuis, et illuminabit te Christus.
tr: διο λεγει εγειραι ο καθευδων και αναστα εκ των νεκρων και επιφαυσει σοι ο χριστος
kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

vulg: videte itaque fratres quomodo caute ambuletis non quasi insipientes sed ut sapientes
clem: Videte itaque, fratres, quomodo caute ambuletis: non quasi insipientes,
tr: βλεπετε ουν πως ακριβως περιπατειτε μη ως ασοφοι αλλ ως σοφοι
kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

vulg: redimentes tempus quoniam dies mali sunt
clem: sed ut sapientes: redimentes tempus, quoniam dies mali sunt.
tr: εξαγοραζομενοι τον καιρον οτι αι ημεραι πονηραι εισιν
kjv: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

vulg: propterea nolite fieri inprudentes sed intellegentes quae sit voluntas Domini
clem: Propterea nolite fieri imprudentes, sed intelligentes qu sit voluntas Dei.
tr: δια τουτο μη γινεσθε αφρονες αλλα συνιεντες τι το θελημα του κυριου
kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

vulg: et nolite inebriari vino in quo est luxuria sed implemini Spiritu
clem: Et nolite inebriari vino, in quo est luxuria, sed implemini Spiritu Sancto,
tr: και μη μεθυσκεσθε οινω εν ω εστιν ασωτια αλλα πληρουσθε εν πνευματι
kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

vulg: loquentes vobismet ipsis in psalmis et hymnis et canticis spiritalibus cantantes et psallentes in cordibus vestris Domino
clem: loquentes vobismetipsis in psalmis, et hymnis, et canticis spiritualibus, cantantes et psallentes in cordibus vestris Domino,
tr: λαλουντες εαυτοις ψαλμοις και υμνοις και ωδαις πνευματικαις αδοντες και ψαλλοντες εν τη καρδια υμων τω κυριω
kjv: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

vulg: gratias agentes semper pro omnibus in nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi Deo et Patri
clem: gratias agentes semper pro omnibus in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi Deo et Patri,
tr: ευχαριστουντες παντοτε υπερ παντων εν ονοματι του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου τω θεω και πατρι
kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

vulg: subiecti invicem in timore Christi
clem: subjecti invicem in timore Christi.
tr: υποτασσομενοι αλληλοις εν φοβω θεου
kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

vulg: mulieres viris suis subditae sint sicut Domino
clem: Mulieres viris suis subdit sint, sicut Domino:
tr: αι γυναικες τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν υποτασσεσθε ως τω κυριω
kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

vulg: quoniam vir caput est mulieris sicut Christus caput est ecclesiae ipse salvator corporis
clem: quoniam vir caput est mulieris, sicut Christus caput est Ecclesi: ipse, salvator corporis ejus.
tr: οτι ο ανηρ εστιν κεφαλη της γυναικος ως και ο χριστος κεφαλη της εκκλησιας και αυτος εστιν σωτηρ του σωματος
kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

vulg: sed ut ecclesia subiecta est Christo ita et mulieres viris suis in omnibus
clem: Sed sicut Ecclesia subjecta est Christo, ita et mulieres viris suis in omnibus.
tr: αλλ ωσπερ η εκκλησια υποτασσεται τω χριστω ουτως και αι γυναικες τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν εν παντι
kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

vulg: viri diligite uxores sicut et Christus dilexit ecclesiam et se ipsum tradidit pro ea
clem: Viri, diligite uxores vestras, sicut et Christus dilexit Ecclesiam, et seipsum tradidit pro ea,
tr: οι ανδρες αγαπατε τας γυναικας εαυτων καθως και ο χριστος ηγαπησεν την εκκλησιαν και εαυτον παρεδωκεν υπερ αυτης
kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

vulg: ut illam sanctificaret mundans lavacro aquae in verbo
clem: ut illam sanctificaret, mundans lavacro aqu in verbo vit,
tr: ινα αυτην αγιαση καθαρισας τω λουτρω του υδατος εν ρηματι
kjv: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

vulg: ut exhiberet ipse sibi gloriosam ecclesiam non habentem maculam aut rugam aut aliquid eiusmodi sed ut sit sancta et inmaculata
clem: ut exhiberet ipse sibi gloriosam Ecclesiam, non habentem maculam, aut rugam, aut aliquid hujusmodi, sed ut sit sancta et immaculata.
tr: ινα παραστηση αυτην εαυτω ενδοξον την εκκλησιαν μη εχουσαν σπιλον η ρυτιδα η τι των τοιουτων αλλ ινα η αγια και αμωμος
kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

vulg: ita et viri debent diligere uxores suas ut corpora sua qui suam uxorem diligit se ipsum diligit
clem: Ita et viri debent diligere uxores suas ut corpora sua. Qui suam uxorem diligit, seipsum diligit.
tr: ουτως οφειλουσιν οι ανδρες αγαπαν τας εαυτων γυναικας ως τα εαυτων σωματα ο αγαπων την εαυτου γυναικα εαυτον αγαπα
kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

vulg: nemo enim umquam carnem suam odio habuit sed nutrit et fovet eam sicut et Christus ecclesiam
clem: Nemo enim umquam carnem suam odio habuit: sed nutrit et fovet eam, sicut et Christus Ecclesiam:
tr: ουδεις γαρ ποτε την εαυτου σαρκα εμισησεν αλλ εκτρεφει και θαλπει αυτην καθως και ο κυριος την εκκλησιαν
kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

vulg: quia membra sumus corporis eius de carne eius et de ossibus eius
clem: quia membra sumus corporis ejus, de carne ejus et de ossibus ejus.
tr: οτι μελη εσμεν του σωματος αυτου εκ της σαρκος αυτου και εκ των οστεων αυτου
kjv: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

vulg: propter hoc relinquet homo patrem et matrem suam et adherebit uxori suae et erunt duo in carne una
clem: Propter hoc relinquet homo patrem et matrem suam, et adhrebit uxori su, et erunt duo in carne una.
tr: αντι τουτου καταλειψει ανθρωπος τον πατερα αυτου και την μητερα και προσκολληθησεται προς την γυναικα αυτου και εσονται οι δυο εις σαρκα μιαν
kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

vulg: sacramentum hoc magnum est ego autem dico in Christo et in ecclesia
clem: Sacramentum hoc magnum est, ego autem dico in Christo et in Ecclesia.
tr: το μυστηριον τουτο μεγα εστιν εγω δε λεγω εις χριστον και εις την εκκλησιαν
kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

vulg: verumtamen et vos singuli unusquisque suam uxorem sicut se ipsum diligat uxor autem ut timeat virum
clem: Verumtamen et vos singuli, unusquisque uxorem suam sicut seipsum diligat: uxor autem timeat virum suum.
tr: πλην και υμεις οι καθ ενα εκαστος την εαυτου γυναικα ουτως αγαπατω ως εαυτον η δε γυνη ινα φοβηται τον ανδρα
kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

vulg: filii oboedite parentibus vestris in Domino hoc enim est iustum
clem: Filii, obedite parentibus vestris in Domino: hoc enim justum est.
tr: τα τεκνα υπακουετε τοις γονευσιν υμων εν κυριω τουτο γαρ εστιν δικαιον
kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

vulg: honora patrem tuum et matrem quod est mandatum primum in promissione
clem: Honora patrem tuum, et matrem tuam, quod est mandatum primum in promissione:
tr: τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα ητις εστιν εντολη πρωτη εν επαγγελια
kjv: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;

vulg: ut bene sit tibi et sis longevus super terram
clem: ut bene sit tibi, et sis longvus super terram.
tr: ινα ευ σοι γενηται και εση μακροχρονιος επι της γης
kjv: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

vulg: et patres nolite ad iracundiam provocare filios vestros sed educate illos in disciplina et correptione Domini
clem: Et vos patres, nolite ad iracundiam provocare filios vestros: sed educate illos in disciplina et correptione Domini.
tr: και οι πατερες μη παροργιζετε τα τεκνα υμων αλλ εκτρεφετε αυτα εν παιδεια και νουθεσια κυριου
kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

vulg: servi oboedite dominis carnalibus cum timore et tremore in simplicitate cordis vestri sicut Christo
clem: Servi, obedite dominis carnalibus cum timore et tremore, in simplicitate cordis vestri, sicut Christo:
tr: οι δουλοι υπακουετε τοις κυριοις κατα σαρκα μετα φοβου και τρομου εν απλοτητι της καρδιας υμων ως τω χριστω
kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

vulg: non ad oculum servientes quasi hominibus placentes sed ut servi Christi facientes voluntatem Dei ex animo
clem: non ad oculum servientes, quasi hominibus placentes, sed ut servi Christi, facientes voluntatem Dei ex animo,
tr: μη κατ οφθαλμοδουλειαν ως ανθρωπαρεσκοι αλλ ως δουλοι του χριστου ποιουντες το θελημα του θεου εκ ψυχης
kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

vulg: cum bona voluntate servientes sicut Domino et non hominibus
clem: cum bona voluntate servientes, sicut Domino, et non hominibus:
tr: μετ ευνοιας δουλευοντες  ως  τω κυριω και ουκ ανθρωποις
kjv: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

vulg: scientes quoniam unusquisque quodcumque fecerit bonum hoc percipiet a Domino sive servus sive liber
clem: scientes quoniam unusquisque quodcumque fecerit bonum, hoc recipiet a Domino, sive servus, sive liber.
tr: ειδοτες οτι ο εαν τι εκαστος ποιηση αγαθον τουτο κομιειται παρα του κυριου ειτε δουλος ειτε ελευθερος
kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

vulg: et domini eadem facite illis remittentes minas scientes quia et illorum et vester Dominus est in caelis et personarum acceptio non est apud eum
clem: Et vos domini, eadem facite illis, remittentes minas: scientes quia et illorum et vester Dominus est in clis: et personarum acceptio non est apud eum.
tr: και οι κυριοι τα αυτα ποιειτε προς αυτους ανιεντες την απειλην ειδοτες οτι και υμων αυτων ο κυριος εστιν εν ουρανοις και προσωποληψια ουκ εστιν παρ αυτω
kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

vulg: de cetero fratres confortamini in Domino et in potentia virtutis eius
clem: De cetero, fratres, confortamini in Domino, et in potentia virtutis ejus.
tr: το λοιπον αδελφοι μου ενδυναμουσθε εν κυριω και εν τω κρατει της ισχυος αυτου
kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

vulg: induite vos arma Dei ut possitis stare adversus insidias diaboli
clem: Induite vos armaturam Dei, ut possitis stare adversus insidias diaboli:
tr: ενδυσασθε την πανοπλιαν του θεου προς το δυνασθαι υμας στηναι προς τας μεθοδειας του διαβολου
kjv: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

vulg: quia non est nobis conluctatio adversus carnem et sanguinem sed adversus principes et potestates adversus mundi rectores tenebrarum harum contra spiritalia nequitiae in caelestibus
clem: quoniam non est nobis colluctatio adversus carnem et sanguinem, sed adversus principes, et potestates, adversus mundi rectores tenebrarum harum, contra spiritualia nequiti, in clestibus.
tr: οτι ουκ εστιν ημιν η παλη προς αιμα και σαρκα αλλα προς τας αρχας προς τας εξουσιας προς τους κοσμοκρατορας του σκοτους του αιωνος τουτου προς τα πνευματικα της πονηριας εν τοις επουρανιοις
kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

vulg: propterea accipite armaturam Dei ut possitis resistere in die malo et omnibus perfectis stare
clem: Propterea accipite armaturam Dei, ut possitis resistere in die malo, et in omnibus perfeci stare.
tr: δια τουτο αναλαβετε την πανοπλιαν του θεου ινα δυνηθητε αντιστηναι εν τη ημερα τη πονηρα και απαντα κατεργασαμενοι στηναι
kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

vulg: state ergo succincti lumbos vestros in veritate et induti loricam iustitiae
clem: State ergo succincti lumbos vestros in veritate, et induti loricam justiti,
tr: στητε ουν περιζωσαμενοι την οσφυν υμων εν αληθεια και ενδυσαμενοι τον θωρακα της δικαιοσυνης
kjv: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

vulg: et calciati pedes in praeparatione evangelii pacis
clem: et calceati pedes in prparatione Evangelii pacis,
tr: και υποδησαμενοι τους ποδας εν ετοιμασια του ευαγγελιου της ειρηνης
kjv: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

vulg: in omnibus sumentes scutum fidei in quo possitis omnia tela nequissimi ignea extinguere
clem: in omnibus sumentes scutum fidei, in quo possitis omnia tela nequissimi ignea extinguere:
tr: επι πασιν αναλαβοντες τον θυρεον της πιστεως εν ω δυνησεσθε παντα τα βελη του πονηρου τα πεπυρωμενα σβεσαι
kjv: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

vulg: et galeam salutis adsumite et gladium Spiritus quod est verbum Dei
clem: et galeam salutis assumite, et gladium spiritus (quod est verbum Dei),
tr: και την περικεφαλαιαν του σωτηριου δεξασθε και την μαχαιραν του πνευματος ο εστιν ρημα θεου
kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

vulg: per omnem orationem et obsecrationem orantes omni tempore in Spiritu et in ipso vigilantes in omni instantia et obsecratione pro omnibus sanctis
clem: per omnem orationem et obsecrationem orantes omni tempore in spiritu: et in ipso vigilantes in omni instantia et obsecratione pro omnibus sanctis:
tr: δια πασης προσευχης και δεησεως προσευχομενοι εν παντι καιρω εν πνευματι και εις αυτο τουτο αγρυπνουντες εν παση προσκαρτερησει και δεησει περι παντων των αγιων
kjv: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

vulg: et pro me ut detur mihi sermo in apertione oris mei cum fiducia notum facere mysterium evangelii
clem: et pro me, ut detur mihi sermo in apertione oris mei cum fiducia, notum facere mysterium Evangelii:
tr: και υπερ εμου ινα μοι δοθειη λογος εν ανοιξει του στοματος μου εν παρρησια γνωρισαι το μυστηριον του ευαγγελιου
kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

vulg: pro quo legatione fungor in catena ita ut in ipso audeam prout oportet me loqui
clem: pro quo legatione fungor in catena, ita ut in ipso audeam, prout oportet me loqui.
tr: υπερ ου πρεσβευω εν αλυσει ινα εν αυτω παρρησιασωμαι ως δει με λαλησαι
kjv: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

vulg: ut autem et vos sciatis quae circa me sunt quid agam omnia nota vobis faciet Tychicus carissimus frater et fidelis minister in Domino
clem: Ut autem et vos sciatis qu circa me sunt, quid agam, omnia vobis nota faciet Tychicus, carissimus frater, et fidelis minister in Domino:
tr: ινα δε ειδητε και υμεις τα κατ εμε τι πρασσω παντα υμιν γνωρισει τυχικος ο αγαπητος αδελφος και πιστος διακονος εν κυριω
kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

vulg: quem misi ad vos in hoc ipsum ut cognoscatis quae circa nos sunt et consoletur corda vestra
clem: quem misi ad vos in hoc ipsum, ut cognoscatis qu circa nos sunt, et consoletur corda vestra.
tr: ον επεμψα προς υμας εις αυτο τουτο ινα γνωτε τα περι ημων και παρακαλεση τας καρδιας υμων
kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

vulg: pax fratribus et caritas cum fide a Deo Patre et Domino Iesu Christo
clem: Pax fratribus, et caritas cum fide a Deo Patre et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: ειρηνη τοις αδελφοις και αγαπη μετα πιστεως απο θεου πατρος και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: gratia cum omnibus qui diligunt Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum in incorruptione
clem: Gratia cum omnibus qui diligunt Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum in incorruptione. Amen.
tr: η χαρις μετα παντων των αγαπωντων τον κυριον ημων ιησουν χριστον εν αφθαρσια αμην   [ προς εφεσιους εγραφη απο ρωμης δια τυχικου]
kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
